data.electoral_count_status_reason: The electoral votes of Georgia were contested and the Senate and the House of Representatives could not agree whether to accept – and count – them or not.
In Georgia, Greeley received 3 electoral votes for President, but these were not counted by resolution of the House.

provenance.ec_source_name: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
provenance.redistributable_note: Redistributable data only. Electoral-college figures come from the U.S. National Archives and Records Administration — Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, 17 U.S.C. § 105) — and cover every election in the snapshot. Popular-vote figures come from MIT Election Lab under CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication) and cover 1976–2024 only; earlier elections carry no popular vote on this surface, and each row's `pv_status` says whether that is because none was held or because no redistributable source reaches it. Per-capita population figures come from the U.S. Census Bureau — Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, 17 U.S.C. § 105). Non-redistributable UCSB / American Presidency Project data is excluded from this public API surface.
